title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow up for maintenance hemodialysis and hypertension.

HPI
Pt is a 67 y.o. female presenting for routine follow up of ESRD. Pt reports stable condition since last visit. Denies any new onset of shortness of breath or severe itching. Reports adherence to hemodialysis schedule. BP remains elevated but controlled with current meds.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Sevelamer 800mg TID
Renal vitamins
Dialysis schedule as prescribed

Exam
BP 142/88, HR 74, RR 16, Temp 98.6. Pt in no acute distress. CTAB. Heart RRR. Lungs clear. No pedal edema noted. Skin intact.

Assessment
1. ESRD: Pt on stable maintenance hemodialysis. Recent eGFR is 12.
2. HTN: Blood pressure remains elevated; continue current regimen.

Plan
1. Continue hemodialysis per current schedule.
2. Continue Lisinopril for HTN.
3. F/u in clinic in 1 month.

Electronically signed
T. Haddad, NP
May 14, 2026
explanations: Hypertension with CKD stage 5 or ESRD: I12.0, plus N18.5/N18.6.
ESRD: N18.6. If a stage and ESRD are both documented, assign N18.6 only.
Patient on dialysis: add Z99.2 dependence on renal dialysis.

distractors.why: I12.9 is for stage 1-4 or unspecified CKD.
The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
Assign N18.6 only when ESRD is documented.
Dialysis status is reported with Z99.2.
